# Axeon Studio
> Axeon Studio installs patient and client intake systems for established private practices: dental offices, med spas, law firms, and accounting/CPA firms. Every missed call and web inquiry gets a reply within 60 seconds, 24/7, the consultation is booked online, and every patient or client is asked for a review after the visit. Based in West Des Moines, Iowa.

The problem Axeon fixes: calls and web inquiries that come in after hours or while the front desk is busy go to voicemail or to a form nobody answers until the next day, and the patient books with whichever practice answered first. Axeon answers first.

**Who it is for**: established private practices, roughly $500k to $2.5M in yearly revenue: dental practices, med spas and aesthetic clinics, law firms, and accounting and CPA firms.

**Plans** (shown on the site as "From $799/mo" and "From $1,999/mo"; there is no self-serve checkout, every plan starts with a call):
- AxeonCORE: from $799/month on a 12-month agreement. The $3,000 implementation fee is credited in full on the 12-month agreement; month-to-month is available with the $3,000 paid upfront; prepaying a year is $7,990 (2 months free). Includes a custom mobile-first practice website (providers and credentials, services, reviews, booking), 24/7 missed-call text-back, a first reply to every web inquiry within 60 seconds, online consultation booking, a two-way text inbox for the front desk, call tracking, automated review requests after each appointment, the AxeonPROOF client portal (live recovered-inquiry counter, change requests, monthly reports), hosting, security and monitoring, up to 2 hours of content updates a month, the 90-day performance commitment, and territory exclusivity for the practice's specialty.
- AxeonGROWTH: from $1,999/month plus ad spend ($500/month minimum, paid to Google directly) on a 12-month agreement, with a $5,000 implementation fee credited. Everything in AxeonCORE plus Google Local Services Ads and search ads management, a quarterly database reactivation campaign to past patients or clients, an AI phone receptionist, multi-provider calendar and intake routing, quarterly photo and video (review videos, reels), a monthly strategy call and a quarterly business review, and priority support.
- Add-ons: Local Services Ads management on AxeonCORE +$750/month, database reactivation $100 per showed appointment, AI phone receptionist +$199/month, extra page $450, on-site videography $1,500.

**90-day performance commitment**: live within 30 days of receiving the practice's materials; every missed call and web inquiry gets a reply within 60 seconds; every completed appointment gets a review request. If Axeon misses any of those in the first 90 days and does not fix it within 15 days, the practice can walk away and owe nothing for the rest of the term. Axeon does not promise a number of leads, patients, revenue, or rankings.

**Territory exclusivity**: one practice per specialty within 5 miles, while the account is in good standing.

**Ownership**: the practice's domain, Google Business Profile, and patient/client contact data always belong to the practice. The website design and code become the practice's once the 12-month term is paid. The intake system, phone and text numbers, and AxeonPROOF are a service and stop if the practice leaves.

**Health information**: intake collects name, contact details, the service requested, and a preferred time only. It never asks for symptoms, insurance, or health details.

**Free after-hours audit** (the main way to start): Axeon calls the practice after hours, checks how fast its website answers an inquiry, and compares its reviews to the top 3 nearby practices. The practice gets a short video walkthrough of what was found, at no charge. https://axeonstudio.co/audit

## Partners
CPAs, practice consultants, and billing firms can refer practices to Axeon and earn a 15% recurring Technology Advisory Share, disclosed to the client in writing, or pass that value to the client as a fee credit instead. Partners request the partner brief by email at hello@axeonstudio.co.

## Service Area
- Headquarters: West Des Moines, Iowa, United States
- Des Moines metro and across Iowa; practices elsewhere in the United States are served remotely
